brief: Revenue reported by PETRONAS for the half year ended 30 June 2026

sections.title: PETRONAS Revenue for 1H 2026
questions: What revenue did PETRONAS report for the half year ended 30 June 2026?
Is the figure consolidated for the group, and what is the reporting currency and units?
sections.tool_rationale: The revenue figure and its context are only available in PETRONAS's official filings for the relevant period, which must be searched directly.
sections.unanswerable_if: If none of the PETRONAS filings for 1H 2026 (specifically 'PETRONAS Interim Financial Report 1H 2026 28.8.2026.pdf') contain a revenue figure for the group.
